risk_description: If driven on the 1st gear and at high RPM, the surface of the resin h  hose of the oil cooler may over-heat from the radiant heat of the exhaust pipe. The resin hose may crack and engine oil may leak. This may cause a fire, or the oil may adhere to the rear tyre, causing the rider to fall.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the type-approval and market surveillance of two- or three-wheel vehicles and quadricycles.
